summary: Frappe Helpdesk is an open-source ticketing application designed to manage and resolve customer service queries. It provides a structured interface for support teams to track incoming requests and apply basic automation rules to their workflows.
goodFor: It suits teams looking for an open-source alternative to proprietary customer support platforms to manage incoming requests on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence places strong copyleft requirements on your deployment, meaning any network-based modifications you make must generally be made available to your users.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage, an external database service, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
